chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: The Alvin Hotel
summary: Jackson recalls musicians at the Alvin Hotel, where Pres and later Shorty Baker died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: The Alvin Hotel was a downtown hotel on -- what's that? -- on 52nd and Broadway.
Well, there was some musicians stayed in there but after a while a lot of the people moved out. The only musician that lived in there almost until he died was Zutty Singleton.
Right. I think Pres died in there, too, didn't he?
Pres died in there and Shorty Baker got sick and he died. He lived in the same room that Pres lived in.
